leftEvidence.title: Judgment is said to be prepared with Adam

points.label: Judgment and remedy
points.left: The dialogue speaks of people perishing despite law and says judgment was prepared when the Most High made the world, Adam, and Adam’s descendants.
points.right: Paul repeatedly sets one trespass, condemnation, death, and disobedience beside the gift, righteousness, obedience, grace, and life through Jesus Christ.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Adam in 2 Esdras · later memory · 2 Esdras 7:68–70
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · Romans 5:15–21

payload.posture: 2 Esdras places prepared judgment with Adam’s creation; Romans places condemnation beside gift and justification.

rightEvidence.title: Adam’s trespass is set beside Christ’s gift

payload.tension: The sources both connect Adam with judgment but differ in argument, sequence, and announced outcome.
payload.title: Judgment prepared and condemnation through trespass
